notices.title: APCA-W3 lightness-contrast formulation
notices.upstream: https://github.com/Myndex/apca-w3 (apca-w3 0.1.9, a devDependency of this package used only by its tests)
notices.evidence: The module's own comments: this package carries no runtime dependencies, so the contrast math is hand-written, and its APCA constants are described there as 'APCA-W3 0.1.9 constants (the W3C-licensed sRGBcalc formulation)' and pinned against the apca-w3 package by test.
notices.unresolved: Known: the shipped code is written in this repository, not copied, and the apca-w3 package itself is a devDependency that never reaches a bundle; what the shipped file reproduces is the published APCA-W3 constant set and formulation. Not resolved here: whether that reproduction carries any attribution or licence obligation of its own. That is a judgement about a published algorithm rather than a packaging fact, so this entry records it and asserts nothing; apps/desktop/notices/README.md carries it as an open item for the separate licensing review.
